implementation_notes: This is a pilot project report (実証結果報告書) accompanying a practical handbook on generative AI adoption in child and family policy domains. Conducted by ABeam Consulting on behalf of the Children and Families Agency. 14 local government entities participated with 45 use cases across document creation, data analysis, chatbot deployment, image recognition, and audio transcription. No binding obligations or penalties are established; findings are intended to inform voluntary adoption guidance.
